correctness.rationale: Exact positive-definiteness of q_h(L) proves no poles and positive determinant for all h≥0. An independently generated complete orbit enumeration of all labeled simple graphs through six vertices gives exactly 142 connected isomorphism classes and 1933 unordered cofactors; 1932 already have nonnegative polynomial coefficients and the sole remaining cofactor becomes coefficientwise nonnegative after (1+h)^32, each with a positive coefficient, proving off-diagonal positivity for all h>0. Exact rational P7 inversions give negative endpoint at h=1 and 3/4 and entrywise positive matrices at h=1/2 and 2. Verified actual checker output against embedded package.

value.rationale: The minimal graph dimension of lost nonnegative-state preservation is a natural finite cutoff for a fixed high-order heat integrator. A mathematically exhaustive all-graph classification through six vertices is substantially stronger than a handpicked example; the unique difficult cofactor requires a nontrivial degree-32 positivity certificate. The seven-path has exact sign loss and recovery although its update is mass-preserving and spectrally nonexpansive, distinguishing algebraic stability from monotonicity. Finite classification is explicitly the scientific outcome; no unjustified infinite-family claim.
